component.name: Layer
component.summary: Record independent screens and sounds, then edit what remains

description.p: Layer is a GPU Screen Recorder source fork with independent display and audio tracks, a RAM replay buffer, and a native recording library and editor.
Choose which screens and sounds remain after recording. Trim and arrange clips, annotate the video, and apply privacy masks before exporting.
Hardware capture depends on the GPU driver, the selected GSR capture path, and desktop permissions. No speech model or personal configuration is included.
